_note: Reception (ADR-058, 2026-11-14): the ball is received where it reaches a player, never at a fixed time; a pass nobody reaches is lost and the ball is anyone's. The difficulty is born at the arrival, as the keeper's catch: (speed / speed_ref + pressure) / 2, speed the ball's as it reaches him, speed_ref the kick's reference speed (kick.json speed_ref_cm_per_tick, the hardest ball a kick produces), pressure = 1 - distance / pressure_radius of the nearest opponent to the ball (influence.json pressure_radius_cm), clamped to [0, 1]; he controls it when his first_touch reaches it. Together, at their references, the two causes demand a perfect first touch: derived from the definitions, no number of its own (RULES A5-bis). Before, a threshold on first_touch plus a bonus for the freedom at the launch minus a penalty for the pass length was judged at due_tick wherever the receiver was, and almost never failed (OI-98). speed_base_cm_per_tick and speed_passing_bonus_cm_per_tick are no longer read since SIM_VERSION 52 (the pass is weighed by the kick, kick.json); Removed-by: the pass kinds of ADR-051. The first touch (2026-11-13, plan L0-CLOSE 11): the ball he wins keeps first_touch_keep_max x (1 - first_touch) of the speed it came with, and runs on from where he took it; he goes after it, and until his foot is on it again it is anyone's.
_source: ADR-058: no value of its own for the difficulty (two references defined elsewhere). loose_control_radius_cm 100 (ADR-041 §5, 2026-11-12): a loose ball within about a stride of a player is his; arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3. first_touch_keep_max_milli: arbitrary, declared (the worst professional's control of a pass arriving at 6 m/s lets it run on about 2 m), to be sourced at L3.
